summary: Structure and coarse physical limits (same numbers as UM21 and GT23) on all 84,793 GT21-RB07 observations of the 22 participants (81,647 phase cycles, 3,146 continuous time recordings). 83,547 have no failure found, 1,246 failed: L2 jump 1,134 (time table, mapped to phase cycles), L1 joint range 186 (almost all ankle angle), S5 side check 16, L5 pressure point 4. S1-S3 pass everywhere. P1 plane glitch is unchecked for every observation (no per-frame plane in the export). Missing data is never a pass: every observation has some missing sample (L4), the side check is missing in 40,800 cycles (force masked in stance). The AB24 ramp_1 wraps (5.8-7.8 rad) and the AB07 segment angle of about 2.2 rad are NOT present in this export: no angle beyond 180 degrees anywhere; AB24 ramp_1 maximum 89 degrees, AB07 cw slow 01_03 maximum 76 degrees. Plate dropout (vertical force 0 with |ankle moment| > 0.3 N*m/kg): 689 observations, 33,465 samples, flagged only. 22 listed short left stances: 18 flagged in the export, 2 flagged as having no toe-off (stance fields empty), 2 excluded by the authors rule and accounted. No scientific approval.

decisions_made_for_jose.decision: Limits: apply D-UM21-Q01-1 = B (coarse limits, blatant errors only) to GT21 unchanged.
decisions_made_for_jose.alternative: Literature or population ranges for GT21; not done (no reviewed range, would tune to a pass rate).

decisions_made_for_jose.decision: L2 only on the 200 Hz time table, mapped to the phase cycles whose span contains the jump (as GT23 v2).
decisions_made_for_jose.alternative: Test the 150-sample phase grid directly; rejected (GT23 showed it is a resampling artifact).

decisions_made_for_jose.decision: Plate dropout is a reported check and a flag; it does not change status or remove anything.
decisions_made_for_jose.alternative: Treat it as failing (drops 689 observations from filtered) or null the moment targets as in the training pipeline.

decisions_made_for_jose.decision: P1 plane glitch stays unchecked (not computable from the export); held bad-fit frames are counted instead.
decisions_made_for_jose.alternative: Recompute from markers with a new native or MATLAB job; not done.

decisions_made_for_jose.decision: Angle samples beyond 180 degrees are flagged as possible wraps (none found); no unwrapping.
Short-stance (early heel strike) strides and the 2 without toe-off stay in the export, flagged; failures from limits do not depend on them.
decisions_made_for_jose.alternative: Drop them (20 strides); not done, keep published values.

decisions_made_for_jose.decision: The export README does not state units; units come from the column suffix (contract). Logged as a finding, not blocking.
decisions_made_for_jose.alternative: Add units to the README at the next export.

findings.l5_failures: 4 observations (AB13 1, AB30 3), pressure point vertical beyond 0.3 m
findings.s5: 16 cycles fail the side check; 40,800 are missing (force masked in stance, mostly ramps and transitions); 3,146 time recordings are unchecked (not applicable)

excluded_in_export.AB08/treadmill/treadmill_07_01/left/0101: authors_rule_discard: more than 2 distinct treadmill speeds inside the step
excluded_in_export.AB23/treadmill/treadmill_02_01/left/0053: authors_rule_discard: more than 2 distinct treadmill speeds inside the step

source_limitations_not_conversion: Ankle angle zero is the D-REF-1 segment-angle difference, unreviewed: ankle L1 failures (about 900 time and phase samples) may reflect offset, not error.
Stance force is masked to missing where no plate carries 20 N: moments, powers, forces and pressure point are missing in many cycles; this is a source measurement limit.
AB27 right thigh and AB28 pelvis limits carried from the export (flagged).
not_checked: Velocities, moments, powers, ground reaction forces, segment-frame values have no limit (unchecked, never pass).
Left-treadmill stance and heel-strike timing are flagged, not judged.
Phase L2 on held frames: jumps across a missing gap are not tested.

code.freeze: pilot_v2 and all 6 batches and the summary bind the same runner hash

jobs.history: pilot v1 and batch b1 v1 (superseded, kept as evidence): the audit lists 22 short stances, 2 of them excluded by the authors rule, and the first code called that a problem; the code now accounts exclusions. readback_v2 receipt not clean only because my own wait loop counted as a new worker; readback_v3 is the clean rerun of the same code.
jobs.limits: 768 MiB address space, 3600 s, one at a time, all receipts clean, cleanup proven

readback.method: independent code (no import of the runner); seeded sample (20261202) of 177 phase observations (about 20 failed and 20 other per participant) and 15 time recordings of AB07, AB17, AB21, AB24, AB25 recomputed from the export tables: L1, L5, L2 and mapping, missing counts, dropout, side check, grid; plus a recount of all 84,793 assessment lines against the summary; 0 mismatches

input_identity: each participant's export hashes equal its RB07 run summary and the RB07 readback (c1-c5, status passed) lists the participant; bound in every job spec
remaining: Release step R01 for GT21 decides filtering using assessment.jsonl; ankle offset and the plate-dropout rule are José's scientific calls.
